title: Beyond Belief: Ethics Without Religion or Identity #shorts

top_liked.author: @LiamODonovan-l6e
top_liked.text: The world would be a better place without any religion. Religion is the biggest divide on the planet

top_liked.author: @TheOriginalChance
top_liked.text: We are moral because we choose to be, and we're immoral when we choose to be.  Most of us know when we're doing wrong, we just choose between what feels good, what we want, and what is right for the collective.
